note: BH-7430 (BH-6896 S3). 1 = a spawn ends at ONE `fly machine run`: the machine fetches the pinned harness sha itself (fly/harness-fetch.sh), its static env comes from the pool app's HBUNDLE_* Fly secrets (bin/fly-pool-secrets-sync.sh), and the per-machine env lines, the job and every relay ride as --file-local seed files. No box ssh, no sleep 20, no ssh sftp, no mput. A spawn whose precondition is missing (no HBUNDLE_SYNCED_AT secret, no git HEAD in the harness checkout, no minted App token, no harness read token, a seed over POOL_SEED_MAX_BYTES) takes the push path and logs `<key>: push path (<why>)`. 0 = the push path, byte for byte. Per-project row `lane.fly-pool.<project>.machine_pull`; turn it on only after the secrets sync and an image bake that carries harness-fetch.sh (docs/notes/2026-10-19-BH-7430-pool-secrets-sync.md). Only the exact value 1 (whitespace trimmed) is on.
